breaking_news.headline: Torn by war, Israelis and Palestinians tie their fortunes together
breaking_news.summary: At a time when hopes are dim for resolving the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, some Arab and Jewish entrepreneurs are partnering across the divide, hoping to prove what's possible.

breaking_news.headline: Diners are staying home, so this restaurant lets patrons pay what they want
breaking_news.summary: Americans are increasingly passing up on dining out. So one restaurant is allowing diners to pay what they like for their food.

breaking_news.headline: After Stephen Colbert's viral talk show parody, CBS backs down from copyright action
breaking_news.summary: CBS and Paramount backed away from copyright challenges to limit distribution of Stephen Colbert's appearance on a Michigan cable access show. He ended his run as host of "The Late Show" on Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Gulf shrimpers want help from Congress as fuel costs climb
breaking_news.summary: The declining number of Gulf shrimpers who are still in business are now struggling as gas prices rise and competition with cheaper imports remains high.

breaking_news.headline: Tired of leaks, the Trump administration wants federal workers to sign NDAs
breaking_news.summary: The Trump administration has proposed creating a new government-wide nondisclosure agreement for new and existing federal employees.

breaking_news.headline: More people are going hungry now than at the height of the pandemic
breaking_news.summary: Food insecurity affects more families now than during the coronavirus pandemic, according to a new survey from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

breaking_news.headline: NPR's newsroom shrinks through buyouts and layoffs
breaking_news.summary: At least 18 NPR journalists have accepted buyouts and another 10 have been laid off as the public media network attempts to save money and reorganize the newsroom.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ charges Google staffer over Polymarket trades netting $1.2 million
breaking_news.summary: It's the second known case of the federal government filing criminal charges against someone who allegedly used insider information to make a large profit on a prediction market site.

breaking_news.headline: Woman caught after 30 years on the run is jailed for armed robberies
breaking_news.summary: Klette was finally caught in a flat in Berlin in 2024 and put on trial last year.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
breaking_news.summary: Hamas says Mohammed Odeh was killed alongside his wife and two children in a strike on a residential building.

breaking_news.headline: Five people found alive after week trapped in flooded Laos cave
breaking_news.summary: The search is continuing for a further two villagers who are still missing, rescuers say.

breaking_news.headline: Matthew Perry's assistant jailed for 41 months over actor's ketamine death
breaking_news.summary: Kenneth Iwamasa, who pleaded guilty last year to one count of conspiracy to distribute ketamine causing death, said he "will forever regret" his actions.

breaking_news.headline: Ebola-hit DR Congo faces 'catastrophic collision' of disease and conflict, WHO warns
breaking_news.summary: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said fighting in DR Congo was hampering efforts to stop spread

breaking_news.headline: Jill Biden says she thought husband was having a stroke during 2024 debate
breaking_news.summary: The former US first lady told CBS News that she was frightened by Joe Biden's performance against Donald Trump.

breaking_news.headline: Israel issues evacuation order for swathes of southern Lebanon
breaking_news.summary: The military says areas south of the Zahrani River are now "combat zones" as it threatens Hezbollah with fresh strikes.

breaking_news.headline: US strikes Iran targets for second time in three days
breaking_news.summary: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

breaking_news.headline: How you can save money on your energy bill
breaking_news.summary: Experts say action now can save money when the pinch comes this winter.

breaking_news.headline: The world's carmakers are struggling to compete with China
breaking_news.summary: The BBC visited China’s EV factories and found they are dominating the ecosystems shaping the global auto industry.

breaking_news.headline: Is 'out of control' US tipping culture spreading overseas?
breaking_news.summary: With US waiting staff getting cross at receiving less than 20%, tips are also on the rise elsewhere.

breaking_news.summary: The longtime Google employee was charged in New York for allegedly breaking insider trading laws.
